adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a transactional consistency issue in addGuests.handler.ts. Looking at the diff, the code at line 92 does `prisma.booking.update()` to persist new attendees, then later calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees()` and `sendAddGuestsEmails()`. If the calendar update or email sending fails, the database already has the new attendees persisted. On retry, the `uniqueGuests` filter at line 73-76 will filter out these already-added guests, causing `uniqueGuests.length === 0` to throw an error, preventing the calendar update from being retried. This is a real atomicity/consistency bug where partial failure leaves the system in an inconsistent state that cannot be easily recovered.
